method: Retain the entire explicit 26-species network and set each named rate factor to 0.5 in turn. Use the same frozen four native EOS auxiliary inputs at T and T exp(plus/minus 5e-5). Twice the full-minus-halved difference isolates a rate direction while preserving the full network context.
checks: Reconstruct the O18 vector component and its analytic/finite-difference temperature derivative. Do not assume that channel heat or weak Q is additive until checked.
